name: Fairphone 3
pros: Wi-Fi support (Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac, dual-band, Wi-Fi Direct, hotspot) for data-free browsing and connectivity
8 MP, f/2.0, (wide), 1/4.0" camera capable of capturing good photos for its release era
Snapdragon 632 chipset provides balanced everyday performance
Li-Ion 3040 mAh battery offers solid operating endurance for daily use
cons: Standard charging speeds without ultra-fast charging support

reviews.title: Solid performance for its 2019 launch era
reviews.body: Picking this up around its release period, the Android 9.0, up to Android 10 experience felt snappy and responsive for the price tier. The 8 MP, f/2.0, (wide), 1/4.0" camera delivered reliable shots in outdoor lighting.

reviews.title: Reliable battery and daily usability
reviews.body: The Li-Ion 3040 mAh power cell paired with Fairphone's software tuning easily lasted through a full work day with mixed web browsing, calls, and media playback.

reviews.title: Refined hardware styling and build
reviews.body: The physical chassis of the Fairphone 3 feels well-balanced in hand. Its 158 x 71.8 x 9.9 mm (6.22 x 2.83 x 0.39 in) make it easy to hold during long daily sessions.

reviews.title: Great value for the hardware specifications
reviews.body: For the price point, getting Snapdragon 632 performance alongside 64GB storage, microSDXC made the Fairphone 3 an easy recommendation among rivals in 2019.

reviews.title: Smooth day-to-day software responsiveness
reviews.body: Operating on Android 9.0, up to Android 10, the user interface is intuitive with smooth system transitions. Core apps and browsing run without noticeable stutter.

reviews.title: Dependable display and audio clarity
reviews.body: The screen (Li-Ion 3040 mAh, removable, 5.65", 1080x2160 pixels) produces vibrant colors for video streaming, and call clarity through the earpiece is crystal clear.

reviews.title: A well-rounded package from Fairphone
reviews.body: Overall, the Fairphone 3 proved to be a durable and well-engineered mobile device representing Fairphone's design philosophy nicely.
